title: Turn tax forms into checkable rules with AI agents
summary: A developer had AI agents encode US federal tax forms as cited data; reports show 1,700 test returns matching three outside tax engines with every difference explained.
agent_role: Language-model agents wrote most of the encoding and code, and separate isolated models re-read the IRS pages to cross-check it. The human set the design principles requiring every line to cite its source.
outcome: The author's reports show 2,313 citation anchors, two evaluators agreeing on 1,648 cases, and 1,700 returns matching three tax engines with differences explained; the author warns not to use it for real.
what_they_did: A developer built a public model of US federal income tax forms, written largely by AI agents. Every form line is stored as data with a citation to an archived IRS page. Isolated models with no repo access re-transcribed worksheets and checked the plain-English versions against the pages. Test returns were run through three outside tax engines.
how_it_went: The repo's reports list 2,313 citation anchors and 0 differences across 1,648 cases between two separate calculators. The author reports 1,700 returns compared with three engines, with no unexplained differences. An outside engine caught a bug on Form 1040 line 9 that all internal checks missed.
worth_knowing: The author calls it a back-burner proof of concept: do not use it for anything real. Agreement between its own checkers does not prove the data matches the IRS text.
prompt: Help me encode [IRS form or worksheet name] for tax year [year] as structured data. Download the official instructions and save a copy. For each line, record the line number, label, the calculation, and a citation quoting the exact passage it comes from. Use only simple operations like add, subtract, smaller-of and multiply by rate. Then write a short checker that flags any line without a citation. Finally, create five sample cases and compare results with [an existing tax calculator]. List every mismatch and its likely cause. This is for learning only; do not file anything.

curation.rationale: Agents encoded IRS tax forms as cited, checkable data with heavy cross-checking and public code and reports; novel and well evidenced, though a non-production proof of concept.
